patterns.note: Grid-based content sections for team members and portfolio cards, often presented against a dark background for visual contrast.
Full-bleed image sections with overlaid text and calls to action, creating a strong, immersive visual impact.
Prominent, large sans-serif headings paired with smaller, lighter body text and uppercase labels for clear information hierarchy.
A sophisticated dark mode aesthetic, primarily using dark greys and black, contrasted with off-white text and accented by a deep blue for interactive elements.
A sticky navigation bar that visually transforms (shrinks in height and gains a solid background) upon scroll, enhancing user focus on content.
Background images in certain sections (e.g., the Golden Gate Bridge) exhibit a parallax effect, scrolling at a slower rate than foreground content to add depth.
A hero section featuring a horizontal carousel of portfolio cards, allowing users to browse key projects without leaving the top of the page.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that dynamically changes its height and background color (from transparent to a solid light tone) as the user scrolls down, using CSS transitions or keyframes for a smooth effect.
Background images in full-bleed sections are implemented with a parallax scrolling effect, where the image moves slower than the foreground content, creating a sense of depth.
The hero section utilizes a horizontal carousel component (likely Swiper, as hinted) to display multiple portfolio cards, allowing users to swipe or navigate through them.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (approx. 3-4x body text) with a clean, modern feel, complemented by smaller, lighter body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons and cards, giving a soft, approachable feel without being overly rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, but a tighter grid for team members and portfolio cards.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dark, sophisticated color palette combined with dynamic scroll-triggered transformations (like the shrinking sticky nav and parallax backgrounds) and an interactive hero card carousel creates a highly engaging and premium feel, setting it apart from typical corporate sites. The execution of these motion elements adds significant polish and depth.
